tasks.goal:
REQUIREMENTS:
R1 The import preview lists every malformed row under its summary with the line number and the reason, in file order
R2 The preview offers 'import the valid rows' which imports every well-formed row and reports how many were skipped
R3 The malformed rows can be downloaded as a CSV with columns line,reason,raw
R4 Each behaviour has a test, and the preview page renders without console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 A search box above the project list filters cards by name and by tag as the user types, without a reload
R2 The list shows 'n of m projects' while a filter is active, and a clear control resets it
R3 The current query is kept in the URL hash so a reload restores the same filtered view
R4 A query with no matches shows a one-line message instead of an empty area
R5 The behaviours have UI tests and the page renders without console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 PATCH /api/projects/<id> accepts {name}, trims it, and rejects an empty, over-long or duplicate name with a 400 JSON error naming the rule
R2 A renamed project persists through _save_projects and survives a reload
R3 Each card has an inline rename control: Enter saves, Escape cancels, and a rejected name shows the server's reason beside the field
R4 Renaming keeps every tag and recording attached to the project
R5 Endpoint, persistence and UI behaviours each have a test

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 GET /api/projects/<id>/tags.csv returns the project's tags as CSV with exactly the columns the import preview accepts
R2 GET /api/tags.csv returns every project's tags with a leading project column
R3 Values containing commas, quotes or newlines are quoted so the file re-imports unchanged
R4 The response carries a Content-Disposition filename, and each card links to its export
R5 A test round-trips an export through the import preview with no malformed rows

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 With no projects, the list area shows an empty-state panel with a one-line explanation and a button that focuses the create form
R2 The panel disappears the moment the first project is created, without a reload
R3 Deleting the last project brings the panel back
R4 The panel has a UI test for each transition and renders without console errors

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 Any video or recording download whose resolved path falls outside the configured videos directory is refused with 403 and a JSON body whose error is denied
R2 Traversal segments, absolute paths, URL-encoded separators and a symlink pointing outside the directory are all refused
R3 A refused request is logged once with the client address and the fact of refusal, never echoing the requested path
R4 Normal downloads keep working unchanged
R5 A test covers every refused shape and one normal download

REQUIREMENTS:
R1 The projects JSON file carries a top-level schema version
R2 A file without a version is migrated in memory to version 1 with every project, tag and recording reference preserved exactly, and written back once
R3 Before the write-back the original file is copied to a timestamped backup beside it
R4 The write is atomic: a crash mid-write leaves either the old file or the new one, never a partial file
R5 A file with a version newer than the code knows is refused at startup with a clear error naming both versions
R6 A test covers each shape: unversioned, version 1, newer, and the backup
